# algolia_clusters (Data Source)

Use this data source to list every cluster in a multi-cluster (MCM) Algolia application. Only available on applications with multi-cluster management enabled; calling this on a single-cluster application returns an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algolia_clusters" "example" {}

output "cluster_names" {
  value = [for cluster in data.algolia_clusters.example.clusters : cluster.cluster_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) Every cluster in the application. The underlying ListClusters API is deprecated and only returns cluster names - no per-cluster record counts, user counts, or data size. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this listing. Set to the Algolia application ID.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name.
